findings.problem: The actual freeze producer writes before and after snapshots for changed|new, representing the new helper before state with a zero-byte file. v2 instead requires only four before files and explicitly forbids the new helper snapshot. It will reject the current valid retained source evidence.
findings.required_change: Match the actual freeze contract: require all five before/after paths, verify four existing before hashes against baseline, and require the added helper before snapshot to have exactly zero bytes (empty SHA256 e3b0c442...). Preserve the existing snapshots.

findings.problem: The strict build command expected by v2 is the historical App-only --bin command. The frozen reviewed build.py executes cargo clippy --locked --release -p deadpan-core -p deadpan-store -p deadpan-app --all-targets --features ui-harness -- -D warnings. A successful final build receipt will therefore be rejected.
findings.required_change: Use the exact current reviewed strict command, preserving all-targets coverage. Do not alter the running producer or accept both historical and final command variants.

findings.problem: v2 requires cwd in every measurement receipt row, but measure.py writes name, command, exit, seconds and profile_gate only. Its subprocess cwd is statically SOURCE, and no cwd field is emitted. Every genuine measurement row will fail this check.
findings.required_change: Validate the actual frozen schema and rely on the pinned producer fixed cwd plus exact command paths, or use an explicitly reviewed future producer amendment. Do not invent or retrofit fields into actual command receipts.

findings.problem: The current pinned host-observations.json (SHA eb96925c...) still contains hardware stderr with a PID/thread tuple and an InternalBattery numeric identifier in power stdout. v2 correctly rejects these, contrary to the assumption that this file was already fully sanitized. Replacing the pinned file in place would break running driver pin checks.
findings.required_change: Preserve the pinned original. Derive a clearly named public whitelist-only host artifact under an explicit producer/schema, removing hardware stderr identifiers and the battery ID while retaining useful AC/thermal state. Bind, validate and retain that derived public file; keep original/private identifier-bearing host records excluded from the public package.
